name: Third Eye
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level

DESCRIPTION

You sprout an extra eye from your forehead that grants you a minor bonus to Perception or improves your existing vision. If you have darkvision or low-light vision, you may choose to gain +10 ft. to your vision’s range or gain a +2 competence bonus to all Perception checks.

If you do not have darkvision or low-light vision, you may only choose the bonus to Perception. This extract does not enhance or grant other kinds of senses such as tremorsense or blindsense.

This extract may be taken multiple times and its benefits stack, but in this case the alchemist sprouts multiple eyes.
